// Synthetic pure-source capture. Microsoft AZQR production files remain unchanged.
package region
import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "testing"
 "net/http"
 "fmt"
 "github.com/Azure/azqr/internal/scanners/plugins/region/types"
)
type captureTripwire struct{}
func (captureTripwire) RoundTrip(r *http.Request)(*http.Response,error){ panic("unexpected HTTP in pure capture") }
func TestPrimaryCapture(t *testing.T){
 http.DefaultClient=&http.Client{Transport:captureTripwire{}}
 http.DefaultTransport=captureTripwire{}
 inputPath,outputPath:=os.Getenv("REGION_CAPTURE_INPUT"),os.Getenv("REGION_CAPTURE_OUTPUT")
 if inputPath==""||outputPath=="" {t.Fatal("explicit capture paths required")}
 raw,err:=os.ReadFile(inputPath);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 var cases []struct{Case string `json:"case"`;Input types.RegionComparison `json:"input"`}
 if err=json.Unmarshal(raw,&cases);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 out:=[]map[string]any{}
 for _,c:=range cases{
  scanner:=NewScanner()
  rows:=[]types.RegionComparison{c.Input}
  scanner.calculateScores(rows)
  out=append(out,map[string]any{"case":c.Case,"score":rows[0].Score,"metadata":scanner.GetMetadata(),"table":scanner.generateOutputTable(rows)})
 }
 data,err:=json.MarshalIndent(out,"","  ");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err=os.WriteFile(outputPath,append(data,'\n'),0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 fmt.Printf("Captured %d pure comparisons; no Scan, credentials or service clients invoked\n",len(out))
}
